title: 文字变3D世界：群核科技新模型，电影行业会因此改变吗？
speaker: Victor Huang

segments.en: Yeah, we released Luxville for this year based on our own model, Spatial Dream.
segments.zh: 今年我们发布了基于自研模型Spatial Dream的Luxville产品。

segments.en: We released a new version of Spatial Dream for Spatial Intelligence.
segments.zh: 我们发布了新版本Spatial Dream，用于空间智能。

segments.en: It can generate a 3D world by text or images.
segments.zh: 它可以通过文字或图片生成3D世界。

segments.en: We are going to benefit just many different domain like filming that will be released in Luxville.
segments.zh: 它将惠及多个领域，比如电影制作，将在Luxville中发布。

segments.en: Then we also use this new model on different domain like virtual touring and real estate and something else.
segments.zh: 我们还将这个新模型用于虚拟游览、地产等领域。

segments.en: So, it can benefit also the robotic training.
segments.zh: 它还能用于机器人训练。

segments.en: We hope the new model can benefit more and more industry.
segments.zh: 我们希望新模型能惠及更多行业。

segments.en: So, this really opens up new revenue drivers for you right going into video generation that can benefit the film industry.
segments.zh: 这为您开辟了新的收入来源，进入视频生成领域，惠及电影行业。
